messages.subject: Knitr, xelatex and tikr, unable to process a minimal example
parts:
Greetings,

I asked (as per the adive on knitr's webpage) this question in stackoverflow but fiven the lack of replies perhaps someone in the group can take an additional look.

I think I have made the issue clear in my question (http://stackoverflow.com/questions/22758249/knitr-with-xelatex-and-tikz-ghostscript-error-on-minimal-example), but to summarise: I can't seem to be able to process a minimal knitr example when using xelatex, knitr and tikz. The document and error message can be seen here: http://paste.lisp.org/display/141859 .

If nothing else I would welcome feedback from others regarding processing the above document with the same combination, that would at least point towards something specific to my setup (or setups since I have been unable to make it work in two different systems).

Best regards,

Frederico
